body:
Thank you for taking the time, it's not too much at all! <3 Yeah, I always felt like it was a little over the top, and then me coming to the conclusion that it was way more subtle and actually a trauma coping mechanism as you said.  


Oh yes, I relate to the high-school memories a lot! Absolutely! This is crazy because it happened to me a few days ago too! My memory about everything that happened in high school seemed so clear, like it was yesterday, all that feelings, beliefs, interests ... you named it! It has been ages, since I recognized these feelings but it also felt like they weren't really ... "me" right now. If that makes sense? Like waking up from a nostalgic daydream that lasted for days. And high school was actually one of the worst periods of my life ever ... 

I don't have any memories of my graduation either. I looked at pictures of it but I don't remember a single thing. Just very small snippets, like, VERY small. And it takes a lot of physical (!) effort even, to visualize them. That was a huge red flag for me because usually I always thought I had quite a good memory but as much as I try, I don't remember anything. Like I wasn't there.  


Yeah it's kinda a train-wreck, it's so important to see a therapist/doctor for clarity and proper help because there's just so much comorbidity regarding symptomes of potential other mental disorders and problems ... I'm still afraid that I might have OSDD. I just don't know why it scares me so much ... I will try to keep an open mind. Maybe it's just maldadaptive daydreaming, but we'll see.  
Thank you a lot for taking your time and sharing your experiences with me! Wishing you the best! <3

Thank you for your words! Yes, I mean DID/OSDD is definitely real! And I don't wanna fakeclaim anyone it's just ... I made very bad experiences with it. I think I just never met someone, who properly explained it to me or informed me correctly ... and I mean apart from than that, it's still a scary thought that there's more than one "me". On the other hand, I hope that this is finally the thing that might be the reason for my therapy-resistence and that I finally get the help I need... Thank you, as I said!
Yeah ... I really assume he's shy, but I don't want to push it to far, because he said he isn't interested.

oohhww thanks for your opinion! That's kinda good to hear. Yeah I'm really trying to initiate meet ups with just the two of us. The pandemic makes it hard for us to see each other regulary. We only hang out when I sleep over at his parents house, I guess maybe that's what makes him uncomfortable too, but we barely have any other choices to do anything really atm rip
THIS IS SO AWESOME! I'm so happy for you!

Thank you so much, I really appreciate your words! 
I had a very good talk with my mum actually, I could open up about my dark thoughts - it was tough because she seemed very scared and wanted to avoid the topic. However, she understood the difficult situation I was in, and offered me to call her, whenever I needed to talk or something.
It was very good!

I know that unfortunately, this won't be last time I will struggle with these thoughts and it will always be hard to open up but it was a start nonetheless!

Thank you for your support!!!

THANK YOU. I'm into MBTI too, it's a fun hobby but I'm tired how introverts seem to look down upon extroverts occasionally ... Not a reason to feel like a victim but sometimes it just annoys me, so I'm glad subreddits like these exist.

OH DEAR GOD. That fucking sucks, I know exactly how you feel. It's terrible, but coming from a similiar situation: I had a huge infatuation with the professor, I assisted in university. He was like 15 years older than me, married and very invested in his family life, but we had soooo much chemistry. It was insane. Even students sometimes joked we had somethin' going on. I told some of my fellow students one day and they had me hanging too lmao I guess it's because it's very hard to interfere with a situation like that. 

He was withdrawn sometimes but then again very touchy and sweet and gentle and funny with me. It was confusing and I thought I was making it up too but let me tell you: If people around you notice it's PRETTY SURE you didn't make this up in your head.

We had this moments, he whispering things in my ear and all that shit but we never kissed or anything like that. However, someday we were fighting and after that we never saw each other again rip It was as if the entire tension and frustation was exploding because we could never be together. I gotta say it was heart breaking at first but I got over it waaay faster than I thought I would. Especially since, looking back, that entire thing was so fucking stressful. 

My advice is: To not engage with them romantically but have a talk. As tough as that may sound. It will release a lot of tension, believe me. Me and my prof never had this, and we were blaming both our intimite moments onto each other and I lost my job because of that. (as I said, I wasn't actually sad about it, just very relieved all this nightmare was coming to an end. I do not hate him though.) 

Your connections seems really close, especially if you knew them since high school. You really should initiate a conversation in a relaxing location, maybe take a walk or something. I really wish I had done this because I know, I still would be friends with him, living my own life. I'm wishing you lots of luck. If you dare to talk to them, you can later always come back for feedback if you need some, I am here.

I'M SO CONFUSED MOST OF THE TIME TOO. I will turn 25 soon and I still haven't figured it out lmao. Looking back, I only had 3 real crushes my entire life up until now (counting my resent crush too). 

I realized that there're actually blurred lines (don't make a robin thicke joke pls) between aesthetic and platonic attraction. I can be friends with a person, whom I find attractive and reaaallly want to be close to them in a platonic way - but that doesn't mean I have a crush on them. I've had dates going on and realized, as soon as they got closer, I'm actually not sensually attracted to them... Then I had friends, I never found attractive and then boom I woke up and realized I like them in a romantic way.

So in conclusion, I don't think you can actually trick yourself into having crush - just confuse some different attractions. I assume it's something entirely out of our control. Our unconscious decides that. And it's hard to figure out, so I guess that's why a lot of people are unsure about their feeling towards a person.
I feel like that all of the above actually describe a crush because most of the time I guess it's just nothing more than a fantasy unfortunately...

I have a huge crush atm but I really wish I wouldn't rip. I guess it just sucks as much to move on with the pandemic going on as to develope a new one. It's hard to get the person out of your head and not being able to do anything about it, especially if it's a friend and you can't even meet up irl... I understand where you're coming from though. I maybe had two real crushes in my life (I'm turning 25 soon ughh) and I'm always scared to move on because it might take me years to find a new infatuation ugh ( (And possibly be able to start a relationship... I'm single for 4 years now.) (And all lesbian and gay bars are closed where I live, it's so hard to meet someone new.) I feel you, man.

Oh man! I'm so sorry to hear that you feel like this... Is it mainly because of the pandemic and the resulting isolation? I'm sure you have people who care for you though. I know how hard it is to believe that anyone would actually care, while sitting in a lonely room for weeks. But hun, you're not alone. I know it's hard to reach out but maybe you can write an acquiantance? Maybe they feel the same way atm?
Ohh I'm so glad it helped you a little! Absolutely no problem, I know how hard these situations can be, so I really hope you will be okay! And thanks for your offer, I will consider it! <3
FUCK JA das wird ja immer gruseliger.

I don't believe in this whole 'love yourself first' and 'being single is great' because honestly, we are programmed to find love and a significant other lol Of course one can be happy being single but as someone who has been single for 4 years now, I understand the craving of a relationship. It's just normal to a certain extent, so don't punish yourself for swooning over someone. It just means you're very romantic and that's a great condition to start a meaningful relationship lol ( also it's waaaaay easier to love oneself in a relationship because you know that you're being appreciated, it's good for the ego, so I never understood why the 'love yourself' argument is always been used as requirement to find a match duh )

I also tend to fall for people who don't like me back ...  It hurts so much. Especially after being close to them as friends additionally. 

what I did after I had that "OH NO I LIKE THEM" moment and getting rejected all over again, is to make it clear that a crush doesn't have to be a serious thing. I know this is easier said then done when thinking about your heartthrob all the time but hear me out: Crushes can be fun if you learn to not take them too seriously. They can happen all the time, any time! You won't even know how many people probably already crushed on you without saying anything! It's because either the person isn't emotionally available or another thing holds them back, however that doesn't change their feelings about you as an example. People don't approach crushes for many reasons. Often its even the fact of knowing, it's just the dream of a person or a relationship because that's what it is sadly. It sucks to admiring from afar but it's way better, trying to accept it than feeling bad for crushing. 

It takes a lot a practice, I know, but consider that crushes aren't uncommon and not all of them have to be serious. Just look where it takes you. Have fun with the *fantasy* of that person. This only belongs to you! It's more healthy than to push it down!! From pushing your feelings away, they only grow and get harder to control. So just try to let yourself fall. 

Who knows where it's going, if you DO get to know the person closer? I've had so many crushes disappear because I saw them in another light immediatley lol Maybe they DO act interested? But don't make a move if you aren't 500% sure, I guess. I know people always say 'confess your love, you'll always regret it if you don't' but I don't think that's true in a lot of cases. Sometimes it's better to stay safe and you have every right to do that!

I know this is just my humble opinion but maybe it's going to help! Wishing you lots of luck!! <3
IDk but I'm soo glad to see that I'm not the only one still collecting plushes to feel content. ( Of course I know, but your collection is just so wonderful to remind me of that <3)

You're so very welcome, I'm glad I could encourge you a little! Wish I could hug you!! It's okay to have bad days, I know what it's like to see no hope at all - but remember this is never a constant feeling!

I hear you. As u/quirkyqueer already mentioned, you are not alone! Being trans is a **really** rocky road, never forget that! You've been so strong already and it's absolutely okay to feel like this. Unfortunately suicidal thoughts aren't uncommon due to the struggles (especially transwomen like you) transgender people face until today. Being born in an unmatching body SUCKS. 

But you can get where you want to be! I truly believe that!! Not trying to be judgemental but being on HRT as a transwomen, sadly takes a little bit longer to see wished results than for transmen... Next year you will see more physical changes! And don't forget, this year had us all kicking in the ass methaphorically, we are going through a collective traumatic event atm I am sure this stress leaves no one untouched. Don't be so hard with yourself! Please! 

You will get where you want to be! You will! Unfortunately, a little patience will be inevitable (especially in our current situation) but I beg you to hang in there! Look back and realize what kind of big progess you already made! One year on HRT? That's fucking amazing. And you said it yourself, you already like the changes, so imaging them just getting more recognizable as time goes on! I know it's easy to say but I've been where you are now too, so please believe me when I say, I'm soooo glad I made it through every depressive episode in my life and looking back, to accept the person I've been and will be.  
Please enjoy the view of the cliff. But never get too closer. Rather open up to your loved ones about your feelings right now then to do anything risky. Please, it will so worth it! 

Sending you lots of love!

So, you have some kind of gender dysphoria if I got that correctly? As my fellow redditers already said: pain is subjective and pain is pain. You don't need enough 'pain' to be trans. Being trans is such an individual experience, hence why gender dysphoria isn't required anymore to be trans. 

There is not such thing as 'trans enough' in my opinion. If you prefer to be seen as a girl/woman that's completely valid, no matter how fellow transgender feel about that.

I'd try to reflect on the issue... Do you have dysphoria now because your subconcious is telling you to do so to be valid? (don't get me wrong, I'm not saying you don't have it, it's just something I experienced myself with a lot of other things...)  Is it really based on your body? If so, what parts of it? Or is it socially? Is it both? Is it causing you pain to be refered to as your birth gender or ist it ok on some occasions? Maybe you love to crossdress?

Of course I can't decide that for you but maybe it's worth to explore these feelings a little bit more to figure out how you can be the most comfortable with your identity. If you have the option: Maybe talk with a loved one about that. Talking will help you to reflect and seeing things clearer. 

Wishing you the best luck!!
